import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans, AgglomerativeClustering, MiniBatchKMeans, Birch
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture

RANDOM_STATE = 42


def build_preprocessor(df: pd.DataFrame):
    cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["object", "category"]).columns.tolist()
    num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["number"]).columns.tolist()

    numeric_pipe = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ])

    cat_pipe = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
        ("onehot", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False)),
    ])

    pre = ColumnTransformer([
        ("num", numeric_pipe, num_cols),
        ("cat", cat_pipe, cat_cols),
    ], remainder="drop")

    return pre, num_cols, cat_cols


def cluster_and_select(X: np.ndarray, k: int = 2):
    # Candidate models; all produce labels.
    candidates = {
        "kmeans": lambda: KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init="auto", random_state=RANDOM_STATE),
        "minibatch": lambda: MiniBatchKMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, batch_size=256),
        "gmm": lambda: GaussianMixture(n_components=k, covariance_type="full", random_state=RANDOM_STATE),
        "agglo": lambda: AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=k, linkage="ward"),
        "birch": lambda: Birch(n_clusters=k),
    }

    best = (None, -1e9, None)  # (name, score, labels)
    for name, make in candidates.items():
        model = make()
        try:
            if name == "gmm":
                labels = model.fit_predict(X)
            else:
                labels = model.fit_predict(X)

            # Silhouette requires >1 label present
            if len(set(labels)) < 2:
                continue
            score = silhouette_score(X, labels, metric="euclidean")
            if score > best[1]:
                best = (name, score, labels)
        except Exception:
            continue

    if best[0] is None:
        # Fallback to kmeans
        labels = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init="auto", random_state=RANDOM_STATE).fit_predict(X)
        return "kmeans_fallback", float("nan"), labels

    return best


def run(in_path: str, out_path: str):
    df = pd.read_csv(in_path)

    pre, num_cols, cat_cols = build_preprocessor(df)
    X = pre.fit_transform(df)

    name, score, labels = cluster_and_select(X, k=2)

    # Ensure labels are 0/1
    labels = pd.Series(labels).astype(int)
    uniq = sorted(labels.unique().tolist())
    if uniq != [0, 1]:
        mapping = {uniq[i]: i for i in range(len(uniq))}
        labels = labels.map(mapping).astype(int)

    out = pd.DataFrame({"pseudo_label": labels.values})
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

    print(f"{in_path} -> {out_path} | model={name} silhouette={score} | X_shape={X.shape} | labels={sorted(out['pseudo_label'].unique())}")

    run("/app/heart.csv", "/app/output_heart.csv")

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans, AgglomerativeClustering, MiniBatchKMeans, Birch
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture

RANDOM_STATE = 42


def build_preprocessor(df: pd.DataFrame):
    cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["object", "category"]).columns.tolist()
    num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["number"]).columns.tolist()

    numeric_pipe = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ])

    cat_pipe = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
        ("onehot", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False)),
    ])

    pre = ColumnTransformer([
        ("num", numeric_pipe, num_cols),
        ("cat", cat_pipe, cat_cols),
    ], remainder="drop")

    return pre, num_cols, cat_cols


def cluster_and_select(X: np.ndarray, k: int = 2):
    # Candidate models; all produce labels.
    candidates = {
        "kmeans": lambda: KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init="auto", random_state=RANDOM_STATE),
        "minibatch": lambda: MiniBatchKMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, batch_size=256),
        "gmm": lambda: GaussianMixture(n_components=k, covariance_type="full", random_state=RANDOM_STATE),
        "agglo": lambda: AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=k, linkage="ward"),
        "birch": lambda: Birch(n_clusters=k),
    }

    best = (None, -1e9, None)  # (name, score, labels)
    for name, make in candidates.items():
        model = make()
        try:
            if name == "gmm":
                labels = model.fit_predict(X)
            else:
                labels = model.fit_predict(X)

            # Silhouette requires >1 label present
            if len(set(labels)) < 2:
                continue
            score = silhouette_score(X, labels, metric="euclidean")
            if score > best[1]:
                best = (name, score, labels)
        except Exception:
            continue

    if best[0] is None:
        # Fallback to kmeans
        labels = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init="auto", random_state=RANDOM_STATE).fit_predict(X)
        return "kmeans_fallback", float("nan"), labels

    return best


def run(in_path: str, out_path: str):
    df = pd.read_csv(in_path)

    pre, num_cols, cat_cols = build_preprocessor(df)
    X = pre.fit_transform(df)

    name, score, labels = cluster_and_select(X, k=2)

    # Ensure labels are 0/1
    labels = pd.Series(labels).astype(int)
    uniq = sorted(labels.unique().tolist())
    if uniq != [0, 1]:
        mapping = {uniq[i]: i for i in range(len(uniq))}
        labels = labels.map(mapping).astype(int)

    out = pd.DataFrame({"pseudo_label": labels.values})
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

    print(f"{in_path} -> {out_path} | model={name} silhouette={score} | X_shape={X.shape} | labels={sorted(out['pseudo_label'].unique())}")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans, AgglomerativeClustering, MiniBatchKMeans, Birch
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture

RANDOM_STATE = 42


def build_preprocessor(df: pd.DataFrame):
    cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["object", "category"]).columns.tolist()
    num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=["number"]).columns.tolist()

    numeric_pipe = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ])

    cat_pipe = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
        ("onehot", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False)),
    ])

    pre = ColumnTransformer([
        ("num", numeric_pipe, num_cols),
        ("cat", cat_pipe, cat_cols),
    ], remainder="drop")

    return pre, num_cols, cat_cols


def cluster_and_select(X: np.ndarray, k: int = 2):
    # Candidate models; all produce labels.
    candidates = {
        "kmeans": lambda: KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init="auto", random_state=RANDOM_STATE),
        "minibatch": lambda: MiniBatchKMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, batch_size=256),
        "gmm": lambda: GaussianMixture(n_components=k, covariance_type="full", random_state=RANDOM_STATE),
        "agglo": lambda: AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=k, linkage="ward"),
        "birch": lambda: Birch(n_clusters=k),
    }

    best = (None, -1e9, None)  # (name, score, labels)
    for name, make in candidates.items():
        model = make()
        try:
            if name == "gmm":
                labels = model.fit_predict(X)
            else:
                labels = model.fit_predict(X)

            # Silhouette requires >1 label present
            if len(set(labels)) < 2:
                continue
            score = silhouette_score(X, labels, metric="euclidean")
            if score > best[1]:
                best = (name, score, labels)
        except Exception:
            continue

    if best[0] is None:
        # Fallback to kmeans
        labels = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init="auto", random_state=RANDOM_STATE).fit_predict(X)
        return "kmeans_fallback", float("nan"), labels

    return best


def run(in_path: str, out_path: str):
    df = pd.read_csv(in_path)

    pre, num_cols, cat_cols = build_preprocessor(df)
    X = pre.fit_transform(df)

    name, score, labels = cluster_and_select(X, k=2)

    # Ensure labels are 0/1
    labels = pd.Series(labels).astype(int)
    uniq = sorted(labels.unique().tolist())
    if uniq != [0, 1]:
        mapping = {uniq[i]: i for i in range(len(uniq))}
        labels = labels.map(mapping).astype(int)

    out = pd.DataFrame({"pseudo_label": labels.values})
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

    print(f"{in_path} -> {out_path} | model={name} silhouette={score} | X_shape={X.shape} | labels={sorted(out['pseudo_label'].unique())}")

    run("/app/heart.csv", "/app/output_heart.csv")
